title: Habit tracker
audience: For anyone building a few small daily habits.
description: A daily habit tracker app. Tick off your habits each day, or tell ChatGPT or Claude what you did and it records the day in Pinto Notes.
tagline: Tick off a few small habits every day.
note:
Habit tracker

Tick off your habits in the app each day, or tell your AI what you did and it records the day.

## Weekly check-in

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Habit tracker". It is an app, and its data is "Habits/Habit tracker.app/data.json". Read it with fetch before each change. When I tell you what I did today, change it with edit: find the habit ids in collections.habits, then add them to done in the record in collections.days whose date is today (yyyy-mm-dd), or add that record. When I ask for my week, add three short lines under "Weekly check-in" in the note with edit: what went well, what slipped, and one thing to try next week.

asks: Log today: walked, read 30 pages, 6 glasses of water, phone in bed again.
Which habit did I miss most this month?

args.new_string:
## Weekly check-in
**Week of 5 October:** walked six days out of seven and read every evening. Water slipped on the two office days. Next week: a full bottle on the desk before the first meeting.
